creation.detail: Articles, registration, trade register entry, tax number and publication: we prepare your file and lodge it at the one-stop shop.
creation.piecesKicker: What you will need to provide
creation.piecesNote: You will photograph them from your phone once your account is created. No need to prepare them before subscribing.
pieces: A valid identity document for each partner and for the manager.
Proof of address less than three months old for the registered office.
Three proposed company names, in order of preference.
A location plan for the office, or the lease if there is one.
A criminal record extract for the manager, less than three months old.

faq.q: Must I pay in the capital before registration?
faq.r: Yes for companies with share capital: it is placed in a blocked account and released once the trade register entry is obtained.

faq.q: Can I incorporate without being in Cameroon?
faq.r: Yes, by notarised power of attorney. We send you the template and handle the filing.

faq.q: What if my company name is refused?
faq.r: We submit the second proposal at no extra cost — which is why we ask for three.
It is the timeframe observed at the Douala one-stop shop. We chase as soon as a deadline slips.

estimation.detail: Answer four questions: the amount appears immediately, split between the official fees we advance and our own.
estimation.unSeulAssocie: A single partner for this form
estimation.villeNote: Outside Douala and Yaoundé, allow two more weeks: the file is lodged at the regional one-stop shop.
estimation.allerPlusLoin: Would you like to go further?

estimation.note: Indicative estimate based on official rates in force. The final quote is confirmed after review of your project, with no file fee.

histoire.detail: Gabriel NGASSE, a former Total Cameroun manager, sets up the practice to help service station operators keep their books.
Seeing how lost small entrepreneurs were, the firm becomes a genuine partner to small and medium businesses.
Paule Diane HIMSTA takes the helm: a younger team, a new approach to client relationships, a broader portfolio.
Order no. 00000048 of 28 January 2020: the firm becomes an approved management centre.
Douala, and an online platform to send documents and follow your file.
